label: OnDelete() handler
type: the entry point fired on document delete/expiry
note: Consolidates two independent mints ('eventing:ondelete-handler' and 'eventing:on-delete-handler'). A real, recurring API asymmetry with eventing:on-update-handler: OnDelete() does NOT supply the deleted document's body, forcing workarounds (a proxy-doc pattern in one example, KEY-prefix filtering instead of a doc.type field check in another) - confirmed independently in two different handler pages this round via the minted predicate omitsMutationBody.
